name: Dhahran Continental Industries
population: Manufacturing borrowers in the corporate book

method.objective: median lead 2–3 quarters; maximise early hit rate − false-alarm rate within the false-alarm cap, leaving the client at least 15% headroom from today

summary: Proposed package for Dhahran Continental Industries (1 covenant, each at least 15% from today's value), calibrated on Manufacturing borrowers in the corporate book: DSCR (minimum): 1.87x — warned 2+ quarters ahead on 39% of 126 Stage 2/default events (median lead 3 quarters), false alarms 10%.
coverage_note: Even the best covenant level catches only 49% of bad cases 2+ quarters early: covenants are a partial warning and work alongside Early Warning, not instead of it.

findings.title: Template DSCR 1.20x almost never warns: 1% of bad cases caught early
findings.text: The bank's standard level (the deal's covenant package) is too loose to warn: it caught 1% of Stage 2 or default events 2+ quarters ahead.

findings.title: Template Debt / EBITDA 4.00x is mis-calibrated: it would fire on 66% of good borrowers
findings.text: The bank's standard level (the deal's covenant package) is breached in 66% of quarters of borrowers that did not go bad, so a breach says little; it warned 2+ quarters early on 73% of bad cases.

findings.title: Template Current ratio 1.35x almost never warns: 1% of bad cases caught early
findings.text: The bank's standard level (median as-set threshold in the book (Manufacturing)) is too loose to warn: it caught 1% of Stage 2 or default events 2+ quarters ahead.

covenants.label: DSCR (minimum)
covenants.trade_off_line: At 1.87x, 19% headroom: early warning on 39%, false alarms 10%.
covenants.text: DSCR (minimum) at 1.87x; the template 1.20x (the deal's covenant package) warns 2+ quarters early on 1% with 0% false alarms; the borrower is at 2.22x today (+19% headroom)

covenants.label: Interest cover (minimum)
covenants.why_not: no threshold has a 2–3 quarter median lead within 10% false alarms
covenants.trade_off_line: At 3.27x, 48% headroom: early warning on 25%, false alarms 9%.
covenants.text: Interest cover (minimum) at 3.27x; the template 2.50x (the deal's covenant package) warns 2+ quarters early on 12% with 2% false alarms; the borrower is at 4.85x today (+48% headroom); not recommended: no threshold has a 2–3 quarter median lead within 10% false alarms

covenants.label: Debt / EBITDA (maximum)
covenants.why_not: no threshold has a 2–3 quarter median lead within 10% false alarms
covenants.trade_off_line: At 6.00x, 60% headroom: early warning on 49%, false alarms 35%.
covenants.text: Debt / EBITDA (maximum) at 6.00x; the template 4.00x (the deal's covenant package) warns 2+ quarters early on 73% with 66% false alarms; the borrower is at 2.42x today (+60% headroom); not recommended: no threshold has a 2–3 quarter median lead within 10% false alarms

covenants.label: EBITDA floor (% of EBITDA a year earlier)
covenants.why_not: no threshold has a 2–3 quarter median lead within 10% false alarms
covenants.trade_off_line: At 88%, 16% headroom: early warning on 2%, false alarms 0%; the statistical best 98%, 5% headroom would catch 29% with 1% false alarms, but leaves less than 15% cushion.
covenants.text: EBITDA floor (% of EBITDA a year earlier) at 88%; the borrower is at 102% today (+16% headroom); not recommended: no threshold has a 2–3 quarter median lead within 10% false alarms

covenants.label: Current ratio (minimum)
covenants.template_source: median as-set threshold in the book (Manufacturing)
covenants.why_not: no threshold has a 2–3 quarter median lead within 10% false alarms
covenants.trade_off_line: At 1.41x, 16% headroom: early warning on 1%, false alarms 0%; the statistical best 1.60x, 2% headroom would catch 45% with 3% false alarms, but leaves less than 15% cushion.
covenants.text: Current ratio (minimum) at 1.41x; the template 1.35x (median as-set threshold in the book (Manufacturing)) warns 2+ quarters early on 1% with 0% false alarms; the borrower is at 1.63x today (+16% headroom); not recommended: no threshold has a 2–3 quarter median lead within 10% false alarms

data_limits: History is 20 quarters (2021Q3–2026Q2), one partial credit cycle: rates carry wide bands; 126 events in the population.
Outcome is the first Stage 2/3 or default quarter of any of the borrower's facilities (cockpit.corp_facility_quarter); a borrower already in Stage 2 at the start of the window is not an event.
False alarms are measured only on quarters with a full 4-quarter outcome window.
Metrics are the book's quarterly ratios; a covenant tested on audited annual accounts would warn later than shown.
